name: Shroud of Fiery Ash
body:
School conjuration (creation) [fire]; Level alchemist 1, bloodrager 1, druid/shaman 1, magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1
Components V, S, M (a vial of ash)

This spell functions as shroud of icy mist except you create a swirling cloud of burning ash around the target and the spell deals fire damage instead of cold damage.
